_comment: SkillSpector baseline applied to EVERY skill (merged with security/skillspector/<name>.json by scripts/skills-scan.py). Every rule needs a reason. Keep this list short — an unscoped global rule hides a whole finding class; path-scoped rules for the Anthropic office skills live here because the three files were byte-identical.

rules.reason: Least-privilege declaration check: Claude Code's SKILL.md `allowed-tools` is a permission PRE-APPROVAL, not a restriction, so authored skills do not declare capability lists there; tool scope is enforced by the profile's settings.json permissions and claude/scripts/safety-guard-hook.py.
Same as LP1: absence of an `allowed-tools`/permissions block is deliberate in this repo; declaring it would widen auto-approved tools, not narrow them.

anthropics/skills docx/pptx/xlsx: the UTF-8 BOM at byte 0 of the published ECMA/ISO OOXML .xsd schema files is flagged as an invisible-character injection. Path-scoped, so it is a no-op for every other skill.
anthropics/skills docx/pptx/xlsx: os.environ.copy() builds the environment to launch LibreOffice headless; nothing leaves the machine. Path-scoped.
